title: Movies and video games
content: I’ve seen people on here that have been talking about the movie theater, and I finally remembered my own dreams about it. The movie theater is inside of the mall, and I realized there are mallworld specific movies that play, as well as video games that are like immersive experiences when you play, that only exist in the dream world. These movies do not play in my waking reality, so I find it crazy that my dreams are projecting alternative media. There are also musical artists who perform concerts, and it feels like they are truly performing for a real audience, and the artists feel authentic. I most commonly remember Justin Bieber, but there are other bands who play. Sometimes it’s at a football-type arena, sometimes in an indoor auditorium, other times it’s a school auditorium. Do you think that there are outer influences to media like this in dreams? Sometimes it feels like something is trying to program me within my dreams, like distractions. Outside of my dreams, I also believe that the media serves as programming for us, so maybe I am projecting my beliefs. Wondering if anyone else has experienced
